# Test fixtures

`demo_customers.csv` is **synthetic data generated by `tests/conftest.py`**, not a
sample of the IBM Telco dataset. Every `customerID` is prefixed `DEMO-` so a
fixture row can never be confused with a real observation.

It exists so that CI can exercise the full pipeline - load, validate, split,
train, serve - without downloading the real dataset. It reproduces the real
file's *structure* (columns, category vocabularies, the "No internet service"
dependency, the blank `TotalCharges` at zero tenure) but none of its statistics.

**No performance number measured on this file means anything.** Real metrics
come from `make train` / `make evaluate` on `data/raw/`.

This file is not what the public demo lists. Those customers are generated by
`src/churnsense/demo/customers.py`, a separate generator with its own made-up
shares and prices and six-digit `DEMO-` IDs; it has no outcome column at all. The
two are kept apart on purpose: this one needs a learnable churn signal to train a
test model, and a demo customer must never have an outcome.
